title: 菊花賞の後に・“お人形”

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City finishes the Kikuka Sho, and finally she hears praise for her strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she later sees comments on an anonymous message board of people discussing her appearance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan sheds tears out of frustration, while Gold City remains stunned by her unchanged reputation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's almost ready to give up, but I assure her that change will come, although gradually. I suggest she take on the Arima Kinen next.
